aiVerification.summary: Draft is not reliable because the changed factor and outcome parsing are materially incorrect.
issues: Changed factor should be bond/glue type, not filename or generic process changes.
Baseline and test conditions are not resolved despite normal/old bond and 3852-V28 evidence.
Vision VP/CD rows are misparsed as measurement statistics and mix glue IDs, amounts, times, input, OK, NG, and NG rate.
Tension outcome misses the 0.5 kgf spec and relies on uncited row text for old bond.
LED UV comparison context is omitted from outcomes.
correctionPlan: Set primary changed factor to new bond 3852-V28 versus normal/old bond EA6116 if row evidence confirms.
Preserve subgroup keys: date, line, bond amount, press time, wait tension, and process condition.
Rebuild VP/CD as yield/defect outcome using input, OK, NG separate, and NG rate per row.
Rebuild tension outcome with 0.5 kgf spec and separate 2h, 12h, and old bond baseline rows.
Add or exclude LED UV outcome based on the available peak/total rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are insufficient until missing cited row text and corrected row-level metrics are supplied.
